x: (Photo by Ed Lacey) Steve White wins the Surrey Co Junior 100 yards from Sinclair(Surrey AC). Later. he clinched a notable treble by taking the Junior 220 yards and long-jump titles.
Could it be the Ayatollah Sinclair with a new recruit in some strange initiation ceremony- in which case which bit is facing Mecca? Or could it be Mr Paton celebrating his victory in the Surreys?
A newcomer who has outclassed several established names. Sinclair 2nd Cru 84. Yet to obtain the standard of its illustrious forebear.
